decisions.rationale: TiDE was the strongest neural challenger but produced 9.84 percent worse aggregate MAE, 13.55 percent worse peak-state MAE, no positive outer folds, and an excessive single-fold degradation relative to the frozen V1 reference.
PatchTST produced 17.72 percent worse aggregate MAE, 17.00 percent worse peak-state MAE, no positive outer folds, and an excessive single-fold degradation relative to the frozen V1 reference.
N-HiTS produced 26.38 percent worse aggregate MAE, 26.52 percent worse peak-state MAE, no positive outer folds, and the largest single-fold degradation among the governed neural challengers.
